title: Alvin Lucier - I Am Sitting In A Room
summary: Alvin Lucier's 1969 minimalist piece in which a spoken text is repeatedly played back and re-recorded in a room until the room's resonances replace the words. This is the 1981 Lovely Music recording.
why: HN cites it as the canonical work behind repeated re-recording experiments, and a pivotal piece of minimalist music worth listening to patiently.

quote.text: It's a pivotal piece of minimalist music.
